name: MiMo Code
description: Xiaomi's terminal-based AI coding agent built on OpenCode with explicit long-term memory architecture. Features layered memory system (session, project, global, history), Max Mode for parallel sampling with 5 candidates, Goal completion verification, and Dynamic Workflow for orchestration. Demonstrates 65%+ win rate against Claude Code on tasks exceeding 200 steps. Open-sourced under MIT license.
community_quotes: MiMo Code is now released and open-source - 535 points on HN
Your AI Coding Agent Forgets Everything. MiMo Code Doesn't
Terminal-based coding agent built by Xiaomi's MiMo team
Designed for long-horizon automated programming tasks

name: TesterArmy
description: YC P26 startup providing AI-powered testing platform for web and mobile apps. Uses AI agents to perform end-to-end testing with natural language instructions, automating QA workflows for development teams. Agents handle creating tests, running them on schedule or on GitHub PRs, and monitoring production environments to catch bugs before users encounter them.
category: AI agents for dev workflows orchestration

name: Xcode 27 Beta
description: Apple's Xcode 27 introduces agentic coding with direct integrations of models from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI. Features conversational coding agents, planning with agents, UI prototype creation using agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration. Privacy-focused with local Neural Engine processing that completes code without sending source to servers.
community_quotes: Xcode 27 takes the next big step in agentic coding
Apple significantly expanding agentic coding capabilities in Xcode 27

name: Pi Coding Agent
description: A minimal, customizable terminal coding harness that developers can extend with skills, prompt templates, and themes. Operates in four modes: interactive, print/JSON, RPC, and SDK. Built as a model-agnostic shell for building and running AI coding agents with full customization capabilities.
community_quotes: The coding-agent harness you can make your own
A glimpse into the future of software
Pi is a minimal terminal coding harness. Customize Pi with extensions, skills, prompt templates, and themes

name: Kimi Code CLI
description: Moonshot AI's terminal-first AI coding agent built in TypeScript with innovative subagent architecture featuring Coder, Explore, and Plan sub-agents. Open-source MIT-licensed project that integrates large language model coding capabilities directly into terminal environment. Available as both CLI tool and VS Code extension.
